original_test_intent: Verify SUT and approved peer on the same VLAN can reach each other and transfer a known harmless file with matching integrity in both directions.
original_method: Configure or verify both endpoints on the approved tag and addressing, run bounded bidirectional ping, perform tracked bidirectional copies of a defined artifact, compare size/hash, then remove temporary files and network state as directed.
manual_activity: User/network owner supplies and approves both endpoints, VLAN and harmless artifact/transfer contract; agent may configure, test and clean only those exact resources.
required_inputs: DUT/peer parent/bond, same VLAN ID/tag and switch trunk
Conflict-free endpoint IPs/prefixes/routes/MTU and firewall policy
Approved secure file-transfer protocol/port and credentials
Harmless test file source, destination paths, size and checksum
Management isolation, disk capacity, OOB, network/artifact cleanup and recovery
safety_requirements: Verify tag/address/route uniqueness and management isolation
Use a non-sensitive bounded artifact and approved destination paths
Track transfer processes and validate free space/permissions
Stop on management loss, route/tag conflict, service impact, integrity mismatch or storage error
Remove only approved temporary files and restore/persist network state only as directed
agent_execution_scope: Run bounded pings in both directions and transfers in both directions
Record size/hash/throughput and perform approved cleanup
Do not invent topology, expose secrets, delete unrelated data, auto-recover/retry or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Review bidirectional evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient and unsafe: it creates only one sample endpoint and performs one ping, omitting reverse ping and both file transfers.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through secure managed access, verify approved same-tag endpoints, run bounded ping each way, copy the approved artifact each way, verify hashes and clean up exact temporary resources.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Same VLAN, client-to-SUT and SUT-to-client ping, both file-copy directions, success criteria and 5/0 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an identity-locked same-VLAN matrix with bidirectional reachability and checksum-verified data transfer.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact topology, bounded probes, artifact integrity and safe cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Restores every direction omitted by DeepSeek.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Successful ping does not prove application transfer, and successful transfer without checksum does not prove content integrity.

project_override_considerations: IPv4 or IPv6 may be selected, but the chosen address family and both-direction evidence must be explicit; do not silently claim both.
expected_evidence: Client-to-SUT and SUT-to-client bounded ping results
Both transfer logs, byte counts, throughput, exit status and matching hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree on same-VLAN reachability; DeepSeek is incomplete rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Peer/topology/file inputs are execution prerequisites and do not block static review.

review_improvement: Restores full bidirectional network and data coverage and adds verifiable artifact integrity and cleanup.
independent_technical_reasoning: VLAN equality is necessary but not sufficient for bidirectional service because switch tags, endpoint routes, firewalls and application permissions can differ by direction. Four distinct observations—two pings and two checksum-verified transfers—are therefore required.
